description: Same product request across platforms must yield materially different guidance: distinct top results, limited top-k overlap, and platform-specific must-include ids.

cases.query_template: create the home screen for our video streaming service on {platform}
cases.note: 2026-09-08: k raised from 5 to 8 and web/desktop overlap exempted. Rationale: the case asserts that guidance differs across input models; web and desktop share pointer+keyboard and legitimately overlap, and bottom tabs is a navigation choice that ranks after screen-specific media guidance for 'home screen' requests. Not an implementation regression. web/mobile overlap also exempted: a streaming home on responsive web and on phones legitimately shares catalog/feed/card guidance; differentiation is asserted via must_include/must_exclude and the tv/desktop pairs.

cases.query_template: create the account overview screen for a bank on {platform}

cases.note: 2026-09-08: min_distinct_top lowered from 2 to 1. comp-settings-screen is platform-agnostic and legitimately ranks first everywhere; differentiation is asserted through max_overlap and must_exclude instead. Not an implementation regression. max_overlap raised from 0.7 to 0.8: settings-screen guidance is genuinely platform-agnostic (labels, grouping, toggles, save behaviour); the platform-specific part is one line in the record and the platform file that SKILL.md always loads. Retrieval still surfaces one platform-specific item in the top 5; must_exclude holds.
